FavoriteBroadcast.title: FavoriteBroadcast
FavoriteBroadcast.description: A broadcast channel or scheduled Temanggung TV program saved to a user's favorites list.

itemId.description: Unique identifier of the channel or program.

title.description: Display title of the broadcast or program.

category.description: Program category such as Berita, Budaya, Agrobisnis, or Siaran Langsung.

scheduleTime.description: Broadcast time window or live label.

note.description: Optional user note or reminder memo.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether the user wants a visual reminder badge for this favorite.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when favorite was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when favorite was last updated.

PlaybackPreference.title: PlaybackPreference
PlaybackPreference.description: User streaming quality and mobile playback settings.

dataSaver.description: Whether mobile data saver mode is active.

autoPlay.description: Whether live stream starts automatically when opening the app.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were last updated.

/users/{userId}/favorites/{favoriteId}.description: Stores each user's saved favorite broadcasts, programs, and live moments.

/users/{userId}/preferences/{prefId}.description: Stores each user's mobile streaming quality and playback preferences.
